## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Found hardcoded values and syntax errors indicating slop.

## FINDINGS
`fetch_pr_review_data.py` contains a critical Python syntax error (multi-line string not enclosed in `"""`) and improperly hardcoded replacement strings (e.g. replacing '165' instead of `{{NUMBER}}`).

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: Syntax error here. You cannot span strings across multiple lines with a single quote/double quote. You also replaced placeholder variables like `{{NUMBER}}` with hardcoded string replacements like `"165"`, which breaks the script for any other PR. Revert this to use `{{NUMBER}}`, `{{TITLE}}`, etc.
